name: Should I finish my garage walls with drywall or install bare modular panel systems?

mainEntity.name: Should I finish my garage walls with drywall or install bare modular panel systems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Finished drywall provides a clean, fully enclosed appearance and significantly improves fire resistance and thermal control when paired with insulation. However, drywall requires careful hanging, taping, and painting, making it a more labor-intensive installation. Exposed stud or slatwall storage options allow for flexible, modular hanging systems right away, but they leave insulation exposed and offer poor dust containment. Many homeowners choose a hybrid approach: full drywall installation on structural walls, accented with custom wood trim or targeted tool-hanging zones built directly into reinforced studs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Drywall offers clean aesthetics, fire resistance, and better insulation, while modular slatwall allows quick hanging flexibility but lacks a polished, sealed finish.
